verdict.rationale: Google Authenticator is a consumer mobile one-time-passcode app that generates, syncs and transfers TOTP/HOTP codes. It does not expose a developer API surface, so an interactive API reference with runnable examples is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any API reference or API explorer that would make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
